{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Artemis|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Artemis''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Power}} II and {{MCW|Multishot}}. It is crafted from four [[Spectral Arrow]]s, three raw porkchops and a [[Silver Bullion]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/power_multishot.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Artemis" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Artemis is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Power applies to bows and Multishot to crossbows. Power II is also available from the Prayer of Exodus [[Ofuda]].

== Trivia ==
* Artemis is the Greek goddess of the hunt and of the moon; the recipe pairs arrows and game meat with silver.
